children: Butler National reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $30.8 million, a 53% increase from the prior-year quarter, with operating income of $7.4 million and net income of $5.3 million. Diluted weighted average shares were 63,954,343 and earnings per share were $0.08 for the quarter. Management highlighted record aerospace backlog and continued share repurchases as part of its capital allocation strategy.
Revenue: $30,781 (three months ended July 31, 2026), up 53% versus prior-year quarter.
Weighted average diluted shares: 63,954,343; Earnings per share: $0.08.
Selected balance sheet at July 31, 2026 — Total assets: $139,520; Current liabilities: $25,762; Long-term liabilities: $27,458; Stockholders' equity: $86,300.
Aerospace Products segment delivered strong momentum: segment revenue rose 92% to $21.7 million driven by increased aircraft modification activity and kit sales for field installation.
Aerospace backlog reached a record $51.1 million as of July 31, 2026, representing contracted work meeting the company’s inclusion criteria.
Avcon completed and delivered two Challenger 605/650 special-mission modification projects, including work under a recently approved STC for an under-fuselage radome/pod and sensor rails.

Avcon expanded special-mission systems integration capabilities with delivery of a CASA CN-235 upgraded with a new sensor package and Avcon-designed workstation, signalling broader integration offerings beyond structural modification.

Professional Services continued steady performance: Boot Hill Casino & Resort saw slightly higher non-gaming revenue and traditional casino gaming growth, while sports wagering via DraftKings declined modestly.
